minimumNumeric.description: Minimum number of numeric characters in password.

minimumCapAlpha.description: Minimum number of uppercase alphabetic character letters in a password.

minimumLowAlpha.description: Minimum number of lowercase alphabetic character letters in a password.

minimumSpecial.description: Minimum number of special character included "~!@#$%^&*()-_=+[]{}|;:,.<>/?" in a password.

minimumLength.description: Minimum length of password. Must be between 8 and 256, inclusive.

historyCount.description: The number of former password in history, the new password can't be any one of them. Must be between 1 and 5, inclusive.

maxPasswordAge.description: The password expired time, unit: day, that means user need to change password every "X" days. Must be between 90 and 1825, inclusive.

notAcceptableStrings.description: The password can not be any one in this string list.
